# Environmental Safety, Sustainability and Risk (ESSR)

> > University of Maryland's central resource for environmental safety, occupational health, research compliance, and sustainability programs.

ESSR provides comprehensive safety programs including respiratory protection, hazardous waste management, radiation safety, and scientific diving operations. The department ensures OSHA and EPA regulatory compliance while supporting research excellence across UMD campus.

## Key Topics

- Respiratory Protection Program
- OSHA 1910.134 compliance
- Hazardous waste management
- EPA regulations
- Fit-testing and medical surveillance
- Radiation safety
- Scientific diving operations
- Research safety protocols
- Environmental compliance
- Occupational health
- Laboratory safety
- Sustainability initiatives
- ASTM testing methods
- DOT hazardous materials (49 CFR 173.300)

## Core Programs and Mission

- [Mission, Vision and Values](https://essr.umd.edu/about/mission): ESSR mission, vision & values for UMD campus safety and sustainability
- [Respiratory Protection](https://essr.umd.edu/who-we-are/occupational-safety-health/respiratory-protection): UMD Respiratory Protection Program: OSHA 1910.134 compliance & fit-testing

## Regulatory Compliance and Reference

- [EPA Hazardous Waste Codes](https://essr.umd.edu/about/environmental-affairs/regulated-waste/epa-hazardous-waste-codes): EPA hazardous waste codes applicable to UMD: acute & non-acute listings

## Research Safety Programs

- [Current UMD Scientific Divers](https://essr.umd.edu/about/research-safety/scientific-diving/current-umd-scientific-divers): Requirements for maintaining active UMD scientific diver status & reciprocity
